archetype: Bold brutalist type — oversized condensed display type, thick rules, full-width stacked sections, numbered sections, sharp-cornered cards. LABEL REUSE (recorded deviation): the Bold brutalist type label was last used Day 5 by Khadim Sweets & Bakers (2026-11-08, cream/maroon mithai shop, Alfa Slab One) and Day 1 by Fazal Din Phajja Siri Paye (2026-11-04, near-black stew house, Anton, full-screen photo hero). Executed visibly differently as a gym: near-black #15161A + signal yellow #FFD400 on off-white #F4F1EA, Bebas Neue + Open Sans, type-led hero with a full-width photo BAND below the type (not a full-screen photo with overlay headline), yellow marquee strip, black trust bar on yellow, numbered sections 01-08, yellow-rule dividers, sharp rectangular buttons. No element of the Khadim (cream/maroon, slab serif, marquee of sweet names, cake-order strip) or Fazal Din (bone/red, Anton, stew-photo hero, process timeline) execution is repeated.
archetype_deviation: Bold brutalist type label reused from Khadim Sweets (Day 5) and Fazal Din (Day 1) with a visibly different gym execution — see archetype field. All 12 spec archetypes are used across 21 sites; brutalist is the task-fixed archetype for this build.
banned_combo: 0 of 4 (cream bg + serif heading + rounded pill buttons + boxed hero photo): base is near-black not cream, display type is Bebas Neue condensed grotesque not serif, buttons are sharp-cornered rectangles, hero photo is a full-width band not boxed.
colour: Near-black #15161A base/bands, off-white #F4F1EA light sections, signal yellow #FFD400 accent (black on yellow ~14:1), steel grey #6E7278 secondary text on paper, charcoal #1E2025 bands, yellow-deep #C9A800 for small text on paper. No orange UI accents. Distinct from Levels Fitness Studio (dark ink #12181F + lime #A3C14A + Oswald), from Fazal Din (near-black + bone + deep red #9E2B25) and from Khadim Sweets (cream + maroon + gold).
fonts: Bebas Neue (display, condensed uppercase) + Open Sans (body, 400/600/700/800) via Google Fonts — neither used by any prior Pakistani site (checked all 21 entries in design-log.json). Distinct from Levels (Oswald + Hanken Grotesk) and from both prior brutalist sites (Anton + Inter; Alfa Slab One + Public Sans).
hero: Oversized brutalist type-led hero on a dark base: giant 'TRAIN HARD. STAY STRONG.' in Bebas Neue (STAY STRONG in signal yellow), eyebrow, lede, 4.8-star rating line and two CTAs — then a FULL-WIDTH training photo band below the type (man setting up a barbell deadlift, Pexels 17210043, cropped right-weighted to drop a blurred foreground pillar), with a thick yellow rule above it. NOT split 50/50, NOT mosaic, NOT carousel, NOT centred badge, NOT full-screen-photo-with-overlay-headline (the sibling Urban Fitness build's hero form).
image_source: Pexels only (per task: keeps IDs disjoint from the sibling Urban Fitness build, which uses Unsplash only). Every image downloaded from images.pexels.com, VIEWED by the builder for actual subject vs trade (7 contact sheets, all 42 candidates viewed; 2 rejected: 6455919 US flag on wall, 11183203 man on phone on leg press — not downloaded), converted to WebP 1600px + 800px srcset, each under 250 KB. No image ID reused from the design log (238 Pexels IDs checked; 1 collision found in candidates, 4162451, excluded). No image repeated within the site.
logo: No verified real logo found — no Facebook/Instagram page and no logo file anywhere public. Clean text wordmark 'PRO PHYSIQUE FITNESS CLUB' with a yellow 'PP' block kept; no logo invented.
